implementation: Shared execution reuses ALMA, JSA and Self Weighted kernels. Bound owned ALMA history by input count while retaining original-period Gaussian coefficients and fixed .85/6 defaults. Avoid JSA lag history when the source cannot reach the original period, preserving its zero-prior mean startup. Self Weighted retains observed-history exact ratios.
